# How Machine Learning Works

> Work out by hand and then in code how a model learns from labelled examples, test it honestly on held-out data, set its threshold from error costs, catch leaks and write down its limits. SDAIA Academy course FND-AIC-101, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 17,988 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Learning from examples](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day1.md): Features and labels, a loss and its gradient, nearest neighbours and a line by hand, and the first honest split; sessions: Features, labels and prediction rules, Loss and gradient descent, Nearest neighbours and linear models by hand, Training, validation and test sets; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day1.html; about 5,280 tokens
- [Day 2: Generalisation and measuring](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day2.md): Overfitting on purpose, cross-validation and learning curves, the confusion matrix, and a threshold chosen from costs; sessions: Model complexity, overfitting and regularisation, Cross-validation and learning curves, Confusion matrix, precision and recall, Thresholds, error costs and base rates; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day2.html; about 3,861 tokens
- [Day 3: Data and leakage](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day3.md): Regression against naive baselines, encoding, scaling and missing values, pipelines fitted on training rows, and four kinds of leak; sessions: Regression errors against a naive baseline, Encoding, scaling and missing values, Pipelines fitted on training data only, Target, duplicate and temporal leakage; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day3.html; about 3,481 tokens
- [Day 4: Model families and limits](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day4.md): Trees, linear models and a small neural network, a later batch from a new sector, error gaps by sex, a model card, and the capstone; sessions: Trees, linear models and small neural networks, Distribution shift, Subgroup error gaps and the model card, Where language models fit, and the capstone; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/day4.html; about 3,943 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a modelling report and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/capstone.md): Ten minutes each: six of talk, then four of questions in which the participant re-runs the notebook and explains a result the instructor selects; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/slides/capstone.html; about 1,002 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: A screening rule by hand](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D1_1_hand_rule.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 35 min
- [Lab 1.2: Two gradient steps on ten rows](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D1_2_gradient_steps.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 35 min
- [Lab 1.3: Two models by hand, then in code](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D1_3_two_models_by_hand.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 40 min
- [Lab 1.4: Baseline, line and tree on a fixed split](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D1_4_three_way_split.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 40 min
- [Lab 2.1: Overfit on purpose](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D2_1_overfit_depth.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 40 min
- [Lab 2.2: Grouped folds and six curves](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D2_2_cross_validation.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 35 min
- [Lab 2.3: Four cells by hand, then in code](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D2_3_confusion_matrix.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 35 min
- [Lab 2.4: A threshold from costs](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D2_4_threshold.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 40 min
- [Lab 3.1: Visit minutes against two baselines](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D3_1_regression_baselines.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 35 min
- [Lab 3.2: A column transformer for the screen](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D3_2_column_transformer.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 35 min
- [Lab 3.3: Selection before the split](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D3_3_pipeline_leak.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 40 min
- [Lab 3.4: Three seeded leaks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D3_4_seeded_leaks.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 40 min
- [Lab 4.1: Three families and a baseline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D4_1_three_families.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 40 min
- [Lab 4.2: A later batch from a new sector](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D4_2_later_batch.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 35 min
- [Lab 4.3: Subgroup error rates and a model card](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D4_3_subgroups_model_card.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 40 min
- [Lab 4.4: The capstone starter](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/fnd-aic-101/labs/D4_4_capstone_start.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 35 min
